## Triage: first grade, `domain:ui` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T22:53Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1 (the filer's):** it is one of the measured causes of cloud#2914 (p1): a 13 s console open on staging, with 30 calls and duplicates. The same resource is asked for several times on every open.
- **For the claimant:** One fetch per resource per open: share the hook state (`useEnvironmentEntitlements`, the session, runtime config). ⛔ No time-based cache that can serve a stale session.

Claim: PM loop round 3 (`priority:p1`; filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat as a measured cause of objectstack-ai/cloud#2914, the 13 s console open, and graded by the triage seat, `6226203136`)
Session: `session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`
Account: `os-sales` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12808-one-request-per-resource`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12808` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#4`
File surface: `packages/app-shell/src/environment/useEnvironmentEntitlements.ts` (one shared, organisation-keyed entitlements resource) and its readers `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/CloudPlanStatus.tsx`, `CloudOnboardingNext.tsx` and `CloudWorkspaceTimezoneNotice.tsx`; `apps/console/src/lib/auth-preflight.ts` and `apps/console/src/main.tsx` (the preflight's session answer handed on); `packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx` and `packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts` (taking that answer instead of a second `get-session`); `apps/console/index.html` (the early `runtime/config` body kept for the page's lifetime) and `packages/app-shell/src/runtime-config.ts` (reading it); tests beside each; one `.changeset/12808-*.md` per released package touched (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (cloud on the maintainer's stance 「可以的话，ui 后续开发尽量用云 session，并且要求截图给我看」; lane scope on 「你也可以接ui车道的卡」; batch 3 on 「当前任务处理完，后续并发降到3」, this session's chat, 2026-10-16)
Clause-②: yes
Clause-② reason: handing the preflight's session to `AuthProvider` likely takes one optional member on `AuthProviderProps`, which `@object-ui/auth` exports. «拿不准 ⇒ 按 yes». If the handoff needs no exported member, the seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` review says so; it comes before ready either way.
Responsibility: n/a — measured duplicate requests on every console open
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: no open objectui PR touches these files (read at dispatch). objectui#12809 (p1, the splash's six serial request waves, unclaimed) is the same boot path; it lands after this card and merges `main`.
